third_party/openskp: the OpenSKP parser subset, vendored and pinned (ADR 0176, R102.a)
================================================================

OpenSKP (MIT, an open-source SketchUp (.skp) reader, not affiliated with Trimble)
  Upstream: https://github.com/iamahsanmehmood/openskp
  Commit: 23a15e8742e936694bf14aa029cb0e2862dce5b9 (2026-10-22)
  Commit archive: https://github.com/iamahsanmehmood/openskp/archive/23a15e8742e936694bf14aa029cb0e2862dce5b9.tar.gz
  Archive SHA-256: 5b304cc024b2d72504ac5a6676968166fdd300f180d3f1078efe8b959951e1a5
  Vendored: the parser subset - the model, the VFF and MFC containers, the TLV and page/
  dimension decoding, the attribute and transform support, and the public headers - plus the
  miniz files it builds with. No exporters, no writer, no scene baker, no tinygltf, no
  flatbuffers. Two files are patched (patches/, documented in PATCHES.md). The licence is in
  LICENSE.

miniz (MIT, the ZIP reader OpenSKP's VFF container uses)
  Upstream: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz
  Commit: 77d0dce8627735138c51770d1799a1ef48f2117d (2026-07-01)
  Commit archive: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/archive/77d0dce8627735138c51770d1799a1ef48f2117d.tar.gz
  Archive SHA-256: baa14349e7c5efb4a493a03af7d2f29d0ef45d87d488567fe5360edb33f8b7ba
  Vendored: the miniz sources and headers the build uses, and its licence in miniz/LICENSE.

scripts/vendor-openskp.py recreates this tree from the two commit archives and fails on any
mismatch; its pin check agrees the commit and archive SHA-256 with dependencies.json.
